scope: Fifteen individually inspected discoveries. These are source-scoped agent reviews, not independent accreditation or a completed review of all 1,000 discoveries. All 81 keyword-flagged entries received wording triage; unreviewed source claims remain open.

records.finding: The exhibition describes a half-turn joining operation and its single connected surface.
records.scope: One continuous side in the ideal joined strip; not a claim about the physical thickness of paper.

records.finding: CERN locates the proposal in 1989 and describes international scientific information sharing.
records.scope: The Web is distinct from the pre-existing Internet.

records.finding: The inventor describes WorldWideWeb as a NeXT browser-editor.
records.scope: The superlative concerns Web browsers; the current display edition narrows the title and source.

records.finding: CERN identifies info.cern.ch and its WWW project introduction.
records.scope: First website, not the first networked information service of any kind.

records.finding: MathWorld identifies three regular tilings; triangles, squares and hexagons satisfy the full-turn angle condition.
records.scope: Euclidean plane; congruent regular polygons, edge-to-edge regular tiling.

records.finding: NASA reports about 9.9 hours per rotation and about 12 Earth years per orbit.
records.scope: Comparison is among the planets of our solar system; approximate rotation, not an exact universal clock.

records.finding: NASA attributes the faint dark-particle rings to Voyager 1 discovery in 1979.
records.scope: Ring visibility depends on lighting and observation geometry.

records.finding: NASA records Herschel in 1781 and the later recognition as a planet.
records.scope: First telescope-assisted planet discovery; not its first possible human observation.

records.finding: NASA describes Olympus Mons as the solar system’s largest volcano with an Arizona-scale base.
records.scope: Comparison is volcanoes in our solar system; no unsupported exact height is added.

records.finding: NIAMS identifies skin as the biggest organ and lists protective and sensory functions.
records.scope: General organ-level comparison, not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

records.finding: The USGS table separates saline groundwater from freshwater and supports a rounded roughly 2.5 percent total fresh share.
records.scope: Freshwater share of all water, not the fraction immediately accessible for drinking; percentage is approximate.

records.finding: APS caption states over 300 kg and water cooling for the first Radarange.
records.scope: Early commercial Radarange; no claim about every experimental oven.

records.finding: The museum records 17 instructions on 21 June 1948 and its digital electronic stored-program qualification.
records.scope: Retain all three qualifiers; do not broaden to first computation or first programmable machine.

records.finding: NOAA distinguishes the occupied largest chamber from the shell’s other buoyancy compartments.
records.scope: Anatomical chamber comparison, not all cephalopods.

records.finding: BnF records the 1377 Korean printing and oldest-known surviving metal-type book distinction.
records.scope: Known surviving book and movable metal type; not first printing of all kinds.
